name: Boycott Detective
description:
The Boycott Detective application is a guide designed to enable consumers to shop consciously and ethically. The application provides users with detailed information about brands and allows them to find out whether these brands are boycotted or not.

Features:

Brand Search: By searching for the brand you want in the search section, you can quickly find out whether it is boycotted or not.

Brand Suggestion: From the suggestion section, you can suggest the brands you want to be added to the application.

Trademark Objection: You can object to brands that you do not think should be boycotted in the objection section.

About: You can get information about the mission and team of the application and contact us from the About section.

Privacy: You can easily access our privacy policy and learn how your data is protected.

Review your shopping habits and become a more conscious consumer with Boycott Detective. For a fair and sustainable world, manage your shopping with ethical values.


NOTE: There may be missing items in the application, they will be added as soon as possible. Thank you for the support you provided us during this process.
